text:
jess: quick follow-up from the morning sync — we ran into a tenant spike that exercised the soft-reclaim path and the behavior was... surprising.
omar: saw it. prewarm credits dropped to 0 then we immediately reclaimed slots, causing a cascade of cold starts.
liang: right, the decay math is too aggressive when bursts come in with short inter-arrival times.
tara: example timeline: tenant A sends 12 large requests over 40s, prewarm credit window was 60s. credits went negative and operator evicted warm slots. :grimacing:
jess: thinking about two knobs: (1) soft-reclaim hold (a short time-based grace) and (2) credit decay smoothing (exponential vs linear). leaning toward a tiny hold + exp smoothing.
omar: preference for hold + fast-path for SLO-sensitive tenants. we already track tenant.slo_weight. if slo_weight >= 0.9 skip reclaim until hold expires.
liang: agree but watch headroom usage. a long hold can starve other tenants. propose: hold = min(5s + 0.1 * burst_qps, 30s) and decay tau = max(10s, 0.2 * window).
tara: can we express that as policy yaml for operator? quick sketch:```yaml
reclaim:
  soft_hold_seconds: ${computed}
  decay: {
    style: "exponential",
    tau_seconds: ${computed}
  }
  slo_exemption_threshold: 0.9
```
jess: yes, we should keep policy simple but tunable. also need observability: emit events when reclaim was skipped due to slo_exemption and when hold veto was active.
infra-bot: deploy-plan created for branch feature/prewarm-smoothing. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/prewarm-smoothing/pulls/12 :rocket:
omar: one more corner: when operator reclaims but the control plane has queued requests for the same tenant (short queue TTL). we need a short reconciliation window where control plane can say "pinned until X" to operator to avoid double-evict.
liang: basically introduce an admission hint: `pinned_until_ts` on lease. operator honors pinned leases even if reclaim heuristics trigger until timestamp passes. cheap and backwards-compatible.
tara: downside: complexity in operator lease encoding + possible clock skew. add jitter tolerance: accept pinned_until_ts + clock_skew_guard=2s.
jess: agreed. action items: 1) add soft_hold + exp decay to operator policy (liang) 2) add slo_exemption hook in admission path (omar) 3) emit reclaim/skip events + dashboards (tara) 4) small e2e sim harness to repro (jess)
omar: put numbers in the PR description with the spike we saw and expected delta in cold-start rate.
liang: will prototype algorithm in go (pseudo):```go
// simplified credit decay
func decayCredits(c float64, dt float64, tau float64) float64 {
  return c * math.Exp(-dt/tau)
}
```
tara: let's also add a circuit-breaker: if cold_start_rate > 10% for 3m, throttle reclaim aggressiveness by 50%.
jess: good safety net. also document the failure modes in the RFC follow-up. keep the operator default conservative.
omar: will schedule a 30m sync tomorrow to review numbers and opt-in toggle. pinging @liang @tara for availability.
liang: free after 10:30 PT.
tara: same.
infra-bot: reminder: canary tag will be `prewarm-smooth-v1` and initial rollout to cluster `staging-2` only.
jess: thanks all — I'll open the design PR and attach the sim traces. :thumbsup:
